task_description: Complete design system overhaul for Madarek EdTech platform: rebuild color/typography/spacing/shadow/transition tokens with new palette (primary blues #5B8DEF-#3B6CC7, teal #4ECDC4, gold #C8962E), redesign landing page to fix visual bugs and implement cohesive premium look, clean up CSS architecture removing duplicates and hardcoded colors, standardize responsive breakpoints, and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA contrast in both themes.

verification.summary: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot run npm install/build/test. Validated via: (1) CSS brace balance verified across tokens.css (8/8), landing.css (192/192), landing-pro.css (36/36), landing-auth-v3.css (54/54). (2) All 43 backward-compatible token aliases verified present. (3) Zero !important in landing.css and landing-pro.css. (4) Zero hardcoded hex colors in inline styles of LandingPage.tsx. (5) LandingPage.tsx JSX balanced (100/100 braces, 28/28 parens). (6) ThemeToggle present in landing. (7) Shared [data-tone] selectors replacing duplicate class-qualified blocks. (8) @layer pages wrapping landing.css, @layer overrides wrapping landing-pro.css. (9) All var(--color-*) in CTA section have hex fallbacks. (10) Responsive breakpoints standardized to 1024px/640px/480px.
